# 2026-11-14 — E6(6) section-selection physics: scalar no-go, 9D duality interface, flux stabilization

## Scope

Central question: can a dynamical term in the actual E6(6) exceptional field theory select the maximal six-coordinate M section over the maximal five-coordinate IIB section, or vice versa?

**Answer so far: no intrinsic section selection is generated by the homogeneous or isotropic-quadratic scalar sector.** A nontrivial fixed-flux kinetic term can conditionally stabilize torus-shape / axiodilaton moduli while respecting M/IIB duality, but a consistent full vacuum and section preference remain unproved.

## 1. The actual ExFT potential, not a hand-imposed selection penalty

Hohm and Samtleben's E6(6) ExFT contains a positive generalized metric M_MN, five external coordinates and 27 extended internal coordinates constrained by its cubic section condition. The six-coordinate section embeds D=11 supergravity; the five-coordinate section embeds type-IIB supergravity. This is established theory, not a deduction from the repository.

For constant external metric g, the published scalar potential (canonical formulation, Eq 3.103) is

  V = -(1/24) M^MN (d_M M^KL)(d_N M_KL)
      +(1/2) M^MN (d_M M^KL)(d_L M_NK).

All other terms in the published V involve derivatives of the external metric. If g and M are constant, every term vanishes on every valid section. The action has no bare 5-vs-6 preference in that homogeneous subsector.

Reference: https://edoc.hu-berlin.de/server/api/core/bitstreams/c2e61a8e-6617-4d02-a91b-df26fe5ff80a/content

### Exact tangent-space and quadratic audit

The signed E6 cubic has 78 certified infinitesimal generators. Decomposition under transpose in the identity positive metric gives 36 skew compact usp(8) generators and 42 symmetric E6/USp(8) scalar directions. The latter comprise 36 symmetric six-edge root matchings and six diagonal Cartan elements.

Using Hilbert–Schmidt orthonormalization with exact rational Cartan Gram inverse, the script proves the matrix identities

  Sum_36 H_root,a^2 = (4/3) I27
  Sum_6  H_Cartan,a^2 = (2/9) I27
  Sum_42 H_a^2        = (14/9) I27.

For h a symmetric cubic-preserving Lie generator and a derivative q restricted to an admissible section, consider M(Y)=exp[epsilon h sin(q dot Y)]. At Y=0, M=I and d_M M=epsilon q_M h. Direct insertion into the published V gives exactly

  V(Y=0)/epsilon^2 = tr(h^2) |q|^2/24 - |h q|^2/2.

An isotropic ensemble over the 42 normalized scalar directions has

  E[V/epsilon^2] = (1/24 - 1/(2*27)) |q|^2
                 = (5/216) |q|^2.

That coefficient is identical for M6 and IIB5 *per unit derivative mode*. Counting six excited M modes and five IIB modes changes the unnormalized total by construction, not by selecting a physical vacuum.

The producer also checks 168 identical coefficients for h with q in the common four-space. For 42 fixed anisotropic basis h, the normalized V_IIB5−V_M6 difference is positive for 22 and negative for 20, with two exact rational witnesses. Thus chosen anisotropic backgrounds can prefer either illustrative profile; no universal branch preference follows.

This no-go applies only to this part of ExFT at identity M, not to the full action, tensor hierarchy, flux, quantum effects, or general curved backgrounds.

## 2. Exact 1080-bridge: shared 9D M/IIB reduction

The native signed cubic has 72 maximal six-coordinate sections and 216 maximal five-coordinate sections. Every independent four-coordinate space belongs to exactly one of each. There are precisely **1,080 such common four-spaces**.

Define the 72-by-216 matrix B with B_M,IIB=1 when their sections share four coordinates. Then each M row has degree 15, each IIB column has degree 5, and the bipartite graph is connected with 1,080 edges.

For the common coordinate core U=(0,1,2,3), its cubic annihilator has dimension 7. Writing its three transverse variables as x (IIB extra direction) and y,z (M extra directions), the strong section constraint reduces exactly to

  x*y = 0,  x*z = 0.

Thus it is the union of an IIB line and M plane, not a linear space supporting both simultaneously. Any attempted mixing of both full derivative frames fails the strong constraint.

The exact integer spectrum of B B^T, proved using an integer annihilating polynomial and five exact trace moments, is

  lambda 3: multiplicity 15
  lambda 9: multiplicity 30
  lambda 21: multiplicity 20
  lambda 45: multiplicity 6
  lambda 75: multiplicity 1.

It follows that B has row rank 72, an IIB-function nullity 216−72=144, and nonzero singular-value condition number sqrt(75/3)=5. This finite incidence transform is not a proof of physical T-duality or a full generalized-metric intertwiner.

Uniform coordinate-section counting suggests prior P(IIB)=3/4, P(M)=1/4. Degree-weighted incidence random-walk stationarity gives P(IIB)=P(M)=1/2. Neither probability is derived from the ExFT action, so the 216:72 combinatorial ratio cannot be sold as vacuum selection.

Physics: five external plus four common internal dimensions give a nine-dimensional reduction. M-theory on T2 and type IIB on S1 are known dual descriptions. Sakatani and Uehara explicitly mapped their generalized metrics and Buscher rules. Hence a physically comparable 9D background may not require either branch to have lower energy.

Sources: https://academic.oup.com/ptep/article/2017/4/043B05/3605261 ; https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-th/9601077 .

## 3. Quantized flux can stabilize shape, without arbitrarily choosing a branch

Consider a pair F,H of integer 4-vectors describing the RR and NSNS three-form flux components on the four independent shared three-cycles. They can also be viewed as a doublet descending from 11D four-form flux components with one M-torus leg.

Let tau=x+i*y, y>0, encode M T2 complex shape / IIB axiodilaton. With the shared base metric and volume HELD FIXED, use the standard positive three-form kinetic contribution

  E(tau) = ||F−tau H||^2/y.

Its integer discriminant is

  D = ||F||^2 ||H||^2 − (F dot H)^2
    = sum_{i<j} (F_i H_j − F_j H_i)^2.

For nonzero rank-two flux, D>0, and exact minimization yields

  tau_star=(F dot H + i sqrt(D))/||H||^2,
  E_min=2 sqrt(D),
  Hessian_(x,y) at tau_star=[2||H||^4/sqrt(D)] I2.

For nonzero rank-one flux, the infimum occurs at the moduli-space boundary, not at a finite isolated stationary shape. For F=H=0, all shapes are flat directions.

Under any A=[[a,b],[c,d]] in SL(2,Z), with F'=aF+bH, H'=cF+dH and tau'=(a tau+b)/(c tau+d), the energy E is unchanged. This was verified exactly in 450 modular transformations of integer flux doublets and rational starting tau.

Selected integer flux witnesses:
- F=(1,0,0,0), H=(0,1,0,0): D=1, tau_star=i, E_min=2 (square T2).
- F=(1,1,0,0), H=(0,1,1,0): D=3, tau_star=1/2+i sqrt(3)/2, E_min=2 sqrt(3) (hexagonal T2).
- F=(2,0,0,0), H=(1,0,0,0): D=0, boundary runaway.
- F nonzero, H=0: D=0, boundary runaway.

These examples are CHOSEN backgrounds, not predictions of a special value for the fine-structure constant or a universal hexagonal geometry. E is a standard kinetic contribution, not the full compactified action. The test does not solve warp factors, internal Einstein equations, tadpoles, Bianchi identities, localized sources, volume stabilization, all scalar EOMs or supersymmetry conditions. It therefore cannot claim an actual supergravity vacuum or dynamical choice of 5 vs 6 dimensions.

Background: https://jaxvacua.readthedocs.io/en/latest/intro/sugra.html

## 4. Literature-based route toward genuine section-dependent physics

The accepted method is generalized Scherk–Schwarz reduction, not an ad hoc section projector potential. An E6-valued twist U(Y) and a density must satisfy generalized-frame and embedding-tensor consistency equations. The resulting lower-dimensional gauged-supergravity potential is determined by the constant embedding tensor X, while geometric uplifts require the strong section condition.

Sources:
- Hohm and Samtleben, E6(6) ExFT action: https://arxiv.org/abs/1312.0614
- Hohm and Samtleben, consistent KK truncations via GSS: https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/JHEP01%282015%29131
- Malek, Sakatani and Thompson, exceptional Drinfel'd algebra: https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/JHEP01%282021%29020
- All maximal gauged supergravities with uplift, 2023: https://academic.oup.com/ptep/article/2023/8/083B07/7239306

A genuine next falsifier is to specify the SAME 5D embedding tensor X and comparable boundary/flux data, construct E6 section-supported twists for both possible uplifts, check the quadratic gauging constraints, solve the complete scalar field equations and compute physical invariants. If both uplifts exist, they may be dual frames. If only one exists, this conditionally selects a geometrically realizable uplift GIVEN X; it does not explain why the universe chose X.

## 5. Orthogonal audits of the other four fronts

The script analysis/toe_20261114_HP3_witness_calibration_and_axis_systematic.py adds the following rigorous systematic-error checks.

Four-copy quaternionic 3-design witness: finite vs Haar fourth moments are eta^4/9 versus eta^4/33. If the per-copy visibility eta is not independently calibrated, the fourth-moment-only statistic is non-identifying when the finite/Haar mean intervals overlap. At central eta=0.8 the critical absolute uncertainty is 0.12879784564873084. An uncertainty of ±0.10 still separates infinite-shot means, while ±0.15 does not. Four copies must share one randomly drawn latent pure state; four independently drawn latent pure states give expectation zero for the product in both centered ensembles.

Hidden-qubit readout: the installed 47-axis protocol tolerates one KNOWN axis being unavailable, but not an undiagnosed persistent sign inversion. Exhaustively testing 72 optimal 21-axis charge menus times 21 candidate inverted axes gives 1,512 cases: 1,080 axes falsely alias 8 of 180 charges, and 432 axes falsely alias 20. More shots cannot fix a systematic sign inversion that produces another permitted charge signature.

Compact USp(8) one-radian preparation: existing actual fixed-pulse regression passes, but the straightforward bounded-power compiler remains expensive (thousands to roughly 165,000 fixed pulses for the studied five state targets). No efficient fault-tolerant optical synthesis is claimed.

Five-qubit maximal Pauli MUB minimum: the independent CaDiCaL encoding of the n=5 size-eight branches 692 and 694 remains UNDECIDED under the executed bounded-conflict searches. The earlier 433,517,130-node exhaustive DFS is strong one-solver-family evidence, but an independent externally verified UNSAT proof is still missing. Do not state that the second solver proved UNSAT.

## Scientific status

Exact code-level certificates: all four new calculations PASS.

Physical status: only a constrained kinetic-term toy model and an exact quadratic ExFT scalar-sector no-go. The M/IIB branch interpretation is a duality-frame question as much as a dimension-selection question. Nothing here derives a complete vacuum, new fundamental constant, measured effect, or Theory of Everything.
